args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they were trapped in a repeating one-hour loop [2]. Those inside the loop who cannot "feel it" forget each entire turn and must live it fresh each time [2]. Consequently, these parties are not dead, but are still perpetually "walking in" every hour, a cycle that has continued for nine years [2].

The mechanism of the loop is as follows:
*   **Cause:** The loop was created when the Lumen Concern dug for lumen and struck "the Whole," causing space to fold and time to become caught [5]. This caused the building to collapse during the first turn of the loop, and it has continued to collapse every turn since [5].
*   **The Reset:** The loop begins when someone crosses the threshold and ends approximately one hour later [2]. When the hour turns, anyone who cannot "hold the deep Facets back" is reset to the top of the stairs or back to the threshold, forgetting that they had previously progressed further into the factory [3, 7].
*   **Ode Marran's Memory:** Unlike the others, Odeline Marran can remember every turn because she is one of the few whom "the loop can't reset" [7]. Having lived the same hour for nine years, she has watched the shaft fold and unfold thousands of times, allowing her to know the timing of the loop to the breath [6, 7].
